data.name: Rafeh
data.gender_notes: Rafeh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rafeh is derived from the Arabic word 'Rafa'a' which means to heal or to cure. It is also associated with compassion and kindness. The name is often given to children who are born with a strong sense of empathy and a desire to help those around them. The name Rafeh carries the meaning “Healing, Compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rafeh usually hope their child will grow to embody healing, compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rafeh is a name that symbolizes healing and compassion. It is believed to bring blessings of good health, emotional well-being, and the ability to provide comfort and support to others.
data.etymology: Rafeh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Healing, Compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rafeh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
